description: Executes a new message call and returns a number of possible traces (Supported on Erigon).

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The transaction call object which contains the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: from
sub_parameters.description: The string of the address the transaction is sent from

sub_parameters.name: to
sub_parameters.description: The string of the address to the transaction is directed to

sub_parameters.name: gas
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the gas provided for the transaction execution

sub_parameters.name: gasPrice
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the gasPrice used for each paid gas encoded as hexadecimal

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description: The integer of the value sent with this transaction encoded as hexadecimal

sub_parameters.name: data
sub_parameters.description: The string of the hash of the method signature and encoded parameters, see the Ethereum Contract ABI

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The type of trace, which can be one of the following:

sub_parameters.name: vmTrace
sub_parameters.description: To get a full trace of the virtual machine's state during the execution of the given of given transaction, including for any subcells

sub_parameters.name: trace
sub_parameters.description: To get the basic trace of the given transaction

sub_parameters.name: stateDiff
sub_parameters.description: To get information on altered Ethereum state due to execution of the given transaction

parameters.name: blockNumber
parameters.description: The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum and Gnosis

array.description: The block traces, which have the following fields (please note that all return types are hexadecimal representations of their data type unless otherwise stated):

array.output.description: The data which is returned as an output encoded in hexadecimal format

array.stateDiff.description: It returns the information on altered Ethereum state due to execution of the given transaction

array.trace.description: It is used to retrieve the basic trace of the given information

array.trace.action.description: The action to be performed on the receiver id:

array.trace.action.callType.description: The type of method such as call, delegatecall

array.trace.action.gas.description: The gas provided by the sender, encoded as hexadecimal

array.trace.action.input.description: The data sent along with the transaction

array.trace.action.value.description: The integer of the value sent with this transaction, encoded as hexadecimal

array.trace.result.description: The integer of the gas price used encoded as hexadecimal

array.trace.result.gasUsed.description: The amount of gas used by this specific transaction alone

array.trace.result.output.description: The value returned by the contract call, and it only contains the actual value sent by the RETURN method. If the RETURN method was not executed, the output is empty bytes

array.trace.subtraces.description: The traces of contract calls made by the transaction

array.trace.traceAddress.description: The list of addresses where the call executed, the address of the parents and the order of the current sub call

array.trace.type.description: The value of the method such as call or create

array.vmTrace.description: It is used to get a full trace of the virtual machine's state during the execution of the given transaction, including for any sub-calls
